summary: GeoPark Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting its Q2 2026 results. The filing details operational and financial performance: production of 27,271 boepd, revenue of $143.3 million, Adjusted EBITDA of $73.1 million, net income of $14.0 million, capital expenditures of $76.4 million, and cash of $316.3 million. It mentions hedging programs, credit facility renewal, and an asset divestiture-related break-up fee from a prior Frontera Energy transaction. This is a routine quarterly earnings release with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review. The category is None. What to watch: any subsequent special-situation announcements arising from ongoing Vaca Muerta development or portfolio optimization.
